summary: Countdown phase handler. Decrements the countdown timer at this+0x10 by the delta-time constant dbl_8AFE98 on every call and returns 1 once the timer drops below 0. While the current-player pointer dword_7C54E0 is non-null, renders the player's grid position character (from byte_5D4AE8 base), driver name string (dword_7C54E0+18168) and team/car name string (dword_7C54E0+18104) at fixed HUD positions, sanitizing each with sub_589901 before drawing.

operations.description: When the countdown timer this+0x10 is negative, treat the countdown as expired and return 1 without rendering.
Decrement the countdown timer this+0x10 by the delta-time constant dbl_8AFE98.
The HUD rendering block runs only while the current-player vehicle pointer dword_7C54E0 is non-null.
Compute the player's grid index as *(dword_7C54E0 + 16480) - 1 and only draw the position character when that index is at most 0x18.
StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck builds the single position character from the base byte_5D4AE8 plus the computed index.
UITextRenderWithScale draws the position character at HUD position (100, 818) with scale 3.0.
Copy the driver name string from dword_7C54E0+18168 into the SrcStr buffer.
sub_589901 sanitizes the driver name buffer before it is rendered.
UITextRenderWithScale draws the driver name at HUD position (210, 818) with scale 1.0.
Copy the team/car name string from dword_7C54E0+18104 into the SrcStr buffer.
sub_589901 sanitizes the team/car name buffer before it is rendered.
UITextRenderWithScale draws the team/car name at HUD position (210, 858) with color 0xFFFFFF and scale 1.0.
Return 0 to signal the countdown is still active; invoked by TimerDisplayRender (004D9DD0).
